cards.title: Shockwave: pick one
cards.text: You asked for two more Shockwave variants. Three to choose from.
cards.why: Tick the one to keep (or more than one, and I'll blend them).

items.label: 1 Ridge
items.text: The one you saw.

items.label: 2 Slabs
items.text: Rock slabs thrust up out of the floor.

items.label: 3 Rolling
items.text: A hump of earth rolls forward, pebbles hopping off it.

cards.title: Wolf bite: pick one
cards.text: You asked for three variations of the wolf's bite. Four to choose from.
cards.why: Tick the one to keep. The wolf's body partly hides the bite on these dummies; it shows better in a real fight.

items.label: 1 Jaws
items.text: The one you saw.

items.label: 2 Chomp
items.text: A big jaw outline closing, tooth marks left.

items.label: 3 Rake
items.text: Three curved fang streaks across the enemy.

items.label: 4 Snap
items.text: A white crescent and tufts of fur.

cards.title: Archer
cards.text: Archer: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Bow (attack)
items.text: The bow is held further forward.

items.label: Frost Arrow
items.text: No ice puddle left on the floor.

items.label: Roll
items.text: She slides back on her feet, and at tier III the caltrops fly out of the slide.

cards.title: Berserker
cards.text: Berserker: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Flail (attack)
items.text: Simpler: the head comes down, a dent and some dust.

items.label: Whirl
items.text: No strings; the heads match the flail in his hand.

cards.title: Granny Reaper
cards.text: Granny Reaper: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Reap
items.text: The scythe is held out; the blood orbs drip on the way and pop when they reach her.

items.label: Old Bones
items.text: No skull: a pale wisp rises out of her and is pulled back in with a flash.

cards.title: Storm Mage
cards.text: Storm Mage: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Zap (attack)
items.text: Thinner, small arms, stronger yellow, and it starts at her hands.

items.label: Chain Lightning
items.text: Starts at her hands. No X where lightning hits.

items.label: Zeus Bolt, tier I
items.text: Reworked: one bolt that leaps between enemies 4 times, shocking each.

items.label: Zeus Bolt, tier III
items.text: Three bolts, 6 leaps each. Busy on four dummies standing close; reads better in a room.

cards.title: Cleric
cards.text: Cleric: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Light orb (attack)
items.text: The orbs fan out by angle and curve in; one passing through an ally heals it a little.

items.label: Mending Ray
items.text: An outlined gold band; the heal symbols are outlined crosses spread round the target.

items.label: Sanctuary
items.text: One ring of light through every post.

cards.title: Bard
cards.text: Bard: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Sour note (attack)
items.text: Sways more slowly.

items.label: Lullaby
items.text: Each note has its own pace and end point, then drifts and fades.

cards.title: Necromancer
cards.text: Necromancer: the clips that changed from your notes.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Soul flame (attack)
items.text: No longer a bone: green soul fire that starts big and slow, then shrinks and speeds up.

items.label: Raise Dead
items.text: The raised dead are plain grey, with even hands.

items.label: Life Drain
items.text: The ribbon grows out to its target first.

items.label: Bone Spear
items.text: Simpler: one tapering bone spike.

cards.title: One fix each
cards.text: Tower, Twinfang, Wildmane, Frost Mage, Druid and Plague Doctor: one changed clip each.
cards.why: Each changed only where your note said. Tick the ones that are right now; comment on any that aren't.

items.label: Tower: Hold the Line
items.text: The red lines to the taunted enemies are gone; a red mark pops in over each one's head instead.

items.label: Twinfang: Backstab
items.text: The smoke fades out, and a second puff appears where she comes back in.

items.label: Wildmane: Cleave
items.text: The greatsword is held straight out through the spin.

items.label: Frost Mage: Ice Shard
items.text: Each spike has a frost trail; chilled units shed slow snowflakes.

items.label: Druid: Entangle
items.text: The earlier cast is back, with the newer entangled look on the enemies.

items.label: Plague Doctor: Poison cluster (attac
items.text: The poof fades out.

cards.title: New heroes and bosses
cards.text: Fixes from the heroes and boss work: the falcon, the rings round heroes, the bosses' spins.
cards.why: You've disliked rings round heroes before, so three new abilities that drew them now burst short sound lines instead. Tick what's right.

items.label: Loose the Falcon
items.text: The bird leaves his arm while it hunts.

items.label: War Horn
items.text: Short sound lines to the front and sides, not a ring round him.

items.label: Mock
items.text: Short sound lines, not a ring round him.

items.label: Showboat
items.text: Short sound lines, not a ring round him.

items.label: Wing Guard
items.text: The wings are longer and in his gold.

items.label: Chieftain's spin
items.text: A spinning blade now sweeps two crescents; bone spikes are only for bone.

items.label: Great Engine's spin
items.text: The same blade sweep on the Engine's head spin.
